ARA reading

The path/history and reverse Rationality coordinates retain chronology: shuffling makes their geometric distances much worse. But their best internal boundary is not the black-hole common horizon. On this signal, rho≈1 across much of the chirp and x_P=1 is crossed repeatedly, so the instrument records a coherent evolving path without uniquely locating the merger handover.

Method boundary

The fourth clock genuinely tested the settled-event idea by using later waveform samples in reverse. It is retrospective and therefore was never compared as a live forecast. Its failure means “read the resolved event backward using the same path boundary” is insufficient—not that every possible Rationality coordinate is ruled out.

Recommended next move

Do not fit BBH:0305 again. Add several SXS systems and freeze a cross-system test of the offset between the common horizon and the state/power crest. That distinguishes a transferable ARA timing relation from a single-waveform crosswalk.
